result: Even on Gaussian linear regression, constant-step SGD has a power-law (heavy-tailed) stationary distribution; the tail index falls as η/b grows and drops below 2 (infinite variance) past η_crit = 2b/(σ²(d + b + 1)).
result_plain: SGD iterates become heavy-tailed from multiplicative noise; larger η/b means heavier tails.
